verdict.rationale: Treg ships a CLI, MCP endpoint and hosted service, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, a setting, or an environment flag. Self-hosting and own-key unmetered calls are different capabilities (deployment choice and billing) and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
